title: Am I insured to drive other cars?
description:
It depends on what type of cover you have. It's included with our Admiral, Admiral Gold and Admiral Platinum comprehensive cover.

But it also depends on a few other factors, like your age, what you do, and some other things. Check your Certificate of Motor Insurance to see if you're eligible, as not everyone is.

You can also only get cover if you have the owner's permission. And just as a reminder, it's only Third party only cover - that means you'll only be covered for the damage you do to someone else's car, not the one you're driving.

Check out some common myths around driving other cars.
